target.outcome: Instantaneous COVID-19 case-fatality rate: article target D'/C; reanalysis uses stated fixed-delay proxy.
target.geography: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales
target.population: Laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases in the four UK constituent nations
target.exposure_assignment: Article: daily country average. Reanalysis: daily mean of valid hourly values at one official UK-AIR representative monitor per nation.
target.model: Article: binomial logistic GLMM/DLNM. Reanalysis: binomial-logit fixed-effect GLM with PM2.5, temperature and sunshine at lag 10 days.
target.named_outcome_source: Public Health England / Office for National Statistics (article); independently recovered Tom White historical UK data compilation (reanalysis)

sources.url: OpenAQ archive S3 and v3 via AERIS

substitutions.published: Daily national average across monitors from DEFRA Air Information Resource
substitutions.reanalysis: One official UK-AIR PM2.5 monitor per nation, daily hourly mean
substitutions.reason: Direct regulator source provided reproducible fit-ready hourly records; retained analysis is explicitly representative-monitor exposure.

substitutions.published: Non-parametric backprojected deaths D' divided by confirmed cases
substitutions.reanalysis: Reported daily deaths shifted eight days and divided by daily incident cases
substitutions.reason: Recovered public historical source does not contain original backprojection input/output.

substitutions.published: DLNM binomial GLMM with country random effects and stage-specific effects
substitutions.reanalysis: Single linear 10-day lag binomial-logit model with nation fixed effects
substitutions.reason: Fixed-delay proxy cannot defensibly identify separate stage effects and four clusters are not suitable for stable random-effect inference.

substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo archive at fixed representative coordinates
substitutions.reason: Public, reproducible daily temperature and sunshine proxy.

coverage.rule: Retain nation-days with nonmissing lag-10 PM2.5, temperature and sunshine and positive daily incident cases; no numeric PM completeness exclusion threshold imposed.
coverage.notes: Joined panel has 696 nation-days; 13 have no daily PM2.5, and lag/missingness/zero-case rules leave 466 model rows. PM2.5 daily availability: England 166/174, Northern Ireland 174/174, Scotland 174/174, Wales 169/174. Full diagnostics are in coverage_report.json.

blockers: Exact article all-monitor national PM2.5 average, backprojNP D' outcome, and DLNM stage-specific model were not recovered; this is a bounded sensitivity, not a matched replication.

effects.label: Bounded PM2.5 lag-10 sensitivity
effects.contrast: 10 ug/m3 increase in PM2.5 at lag 10 days

reported_variants: lag-10 bounded sensitivity; article's three infection-stage variants not separately identifiable with fixed-delay proxy
